summary: Quarterly register refresh: the project spine, compact index and search index move from REPD Q2 2026 to DESNZ REPD Q3 2026 (7,775 projects at >=1 MW from 14,967 source records; was 7,680 from 14,657). Every other panel is carried from the parent unchanged and joins by REPD Ref ID.
modification_note: Replaces registry totals, source, assets.projects, assets.search and detail_partitions through release_builder's registry_core block; the Q2 files stay in the release as inherited, unreferenced bytes so the parent's digests remain true. Three sentences that named Q2 counts are re-counted for this cut.

index.html.label: the cut sentence names DESNZ REPD Q3 2026
index.html.from: Canonical DESNZ REPD Q2 2026: 7,680 solar, BESS and wind records at ≥1 MW.
index.html.to: Canonical DESNZ REPD Q3 2026: 7,775 solar, BESS and wind records at ≥1 MW. Grid distance, locality, project-intelligence and wider-fleet panels are carried from the Q2 2026 cut and join by REPD Ref ID.
